title: The Vibe Open Mic @ Marimba Cafe
event_description: A mixed open mic for musicians poets and other performers at a Latino-owned Hackensack coffee shop with DJ Morae keeping the room moving between sets. Runs periodically on Saturday evenings.
event_venue_information:
Marimba Cafe

A Latino- and veteran-owned specialty coffee shop in downtown Hackensack serving Colombian and Puerto Rican bites.

The Vibe Open Mic

A mixed open mic for musicians, poets and other performers, run periodically on Saturday evenings (doors 6:00 PM, start 7:00 PM) with DJ Morae. Sign up and dates are announced via the host's Instagram, @blankstudios_thevibe.
